title: Typeface Anatomy
slide_intent: Teach designers to identify the parts of a letter that change its voice. Comparing a few letters makes a distinction between related faces easier to see than describing an entire alphabet.
strategic_value: Instacart can explain how Sans and Contrast play different roles through observable details such as stroke contrast and terminals.
demonstration: Two very large lowercase specimen lines sit one above the other. Small annotations and circles point out high stroke contrast, vertical stress and flat terminals.
practical_value: Look at the marked details when deciding whether a specimen belongs to the Sans or Contrast voice.

content_islands.name: Stacked specimens
content_islands.spec: Give both faces a large horizontal line of lowercase letters. Identify each beneath its specimen and leave enough space to inspect curves and strokes.

content_islands.name: Anatomy annotations
content_islands.spec: Use fine contrasting circles and small labels near the forms they explain. Keep explanations attached to the relevant glyphs.
